description: Foxconn T99W175 / Dell Snapdragon X55 in QMI composition

hints.at_source: 05c6:9025 composition DIAG(0) ADB(1) MODEM(2) NMEA(3) QMI(4) (Modem Zoo foxconn-t99w175, 4PDA); field UART 2026-10-12: ttyUSB2 = 1-1.4:1.2. ModemManager ignores this modem's ttys (mm_ports control), so the engine needs the number

bind.source: bench 2026-10-02 (OPi Zero 3, 25.12): option on 00/02/03, qmi_wwan on 04, ADB 01 unbound; automatic by the user's decision (one unit, spec 32.11 exception, F8)

recovery.source: Modem Zoo foxconn-t99w175: restart in operator presets; radio and reset go through ModemManager; not yet bench-validated

radio.source: another modem manager 3.4.0 _qualcomm_sdx55_common (AT^SLMODE mask 1 WCDMA, 2 LTE, 4 NR5G, 0 auto; AT^BAND_PREF=<tech>,2,<list> unquoted, never the bare reset); QModem vendor/foxconn.sh (the same SLMODE table, NR5G_NSA/NR5G_SA lines)

ussd_cs_fallback.source: bench 2026-10-16 (T99W175, Tele2): USSD on LTE fell back to a 3G cell, was rejected (SupsFailureCase) and the data session dropped; ModemManager showed cs 'searching' while eps was 'home'
